tokenTooltip.name: Token Hover Tooltip
tokenTooltip.hint: Show a stat summary tooltip when hovering over character tokens on the canvas.

tokenTooltipSize.name: Token Tooltip Size
tokenTooltipSize.hint: Controls the size of the token hover tooltip.

hopeBarEnabled.name: Token Hope Bar
hopeBarEnabled.hint: Draw a row of Hope diamonds above character tokens, following each token's own Display Bars setting. Turn this off when another module already renders Hope on tokens.

hideBiographyTab.name: Hide Biography Tab
hideBiographyTab.hint: Hides the Biography tab on character sheets for everyone.

cinematicImagesSettingsMenu.name: Cinematic Roll Images
cinematicImagesSettingsMenu.label: Configure Cinematic Images
cinematicImagesSettingsMenu.hint: Assign an image to each Request Roll case. Every case starts on a core Foundry icon; Cinematic Mode only activates for cases that have an image, so a case left empty falls back to a plain chat message.

customTablesSettingsMenu.name: Custom Tables Configuration
customTablesSettingsMenu.label: Configure Custom Tables
customTablesSettingsMenu.hint: Pick the roll tables the Custom Tables roller draws from. Each table is rolled with its own formula.

fallingDamageSettingsMenu.name: Falling Damage Configuration
fallingDamageSettingsMenu.label: Configure Falling Damage
fallingDamageSettingsMenu.hint: Customize the dice formulas for each fall height category.

lootConsumableSettingsMenu.name: Loot & Consumables Configuration
lootConsumableSettingsMenu.label: Configure Loot & Consumables
lootConsumableSettingsMenu.hint: Pick which Daggerheart roll tables loot and consumables are drawn from, and customize the coin range of each tier.

quickActionsMacrosMenu.name: Quick Actions Macros
quickActionsMacrosMenu.label: Configure Quick Actions
quickActionsMacrosMenu.hint: Choose the macros listed by the "Quick Actions" button on character sheets. Drag macros in from the Macro directory or a compendium.

scanSettingsMenu.name: Scan Labels Configuration
scanSettingsMenu.label: Configure Scan Labels
scanSettingsMenu.hint: Customize the descriptive labels and titles shown in the Scan chat card.

uiSettingsMenu.name: Interface Settings
uiSettingsMenu.label: Configure Interface
uiSettingsMenu.hint: World-wide interface changes made by this module, in one place: the Daggerheart sidebar menu enhancements, the token tooltip and Hope bar, and the character sheet Biography tab.

hp.imposing: Imposing; their form is pristine, radiating an aura of untouched power.
hp.weathered: Weathered; minor injuries or disruptions mark their form, but their stance remains firm.
hp.battered: Battered; visible wounds or flickering essence betray the toll of battle, slowing them down.
hp.broken: Broken; they stagger with ragged desperation, their existence hanging by a thread.
hp.fallen: Fallen; the vessel has succumbed, collapsing into stillness or dissipation.

stress.unshakeable: Unshakeable; their mind is a fortress, operating with absolute, terrifying clarity.
stress.guarded: Guarded; a subtle tension tightens their movements, the weight of the moment setting in.
stress.rattled: Rattled; hesitation fractures their focus, erratic energy revealing their inner turmoil.
stress.overwhelmed: Overwhelmed; panic or instability has taken hold, leaving them erratic and unpredictable.
stress.shattered: Shattered; their mental defenses have crumbled, leaving them utterly exposed and vulnerable to any threat.
